author: ojiudezue
title: v5.90.0 shipped: HVAC short-cycle anomaly producer
summary: The HVAC anomaly detector reported nominal while structurally blind on short_cycle_rate — it was declared but never produced, so a short-cycling compressor could never raise an anomaly. This wires the producer, closing a real detection gap. D0 probe (recorder-event fidelity) confirmed clean fault separation at minimum_samples=14; ships with the restart-guard, unavailable-guard, and ctor wire-in anchor that the three reviews demanded.

refs.release_notes: Wires the previously-blind short_cycle_rate metric end to end: event-driven per-zone daily producer (async_track_state_change_event, LOCAL-day, restart-safe counter), per-metric 14-sample maturation gate (minimum_samples_by_metric), scope-aware surfaces, clear_active_anomalies_filtered, and de-suppression so a fire reaches worst-severity and NM. Tier-2-DB, 3 framing-disjoint reviews + consolidated fix-up (clear-before-record, unavailable/unknown guard, callback double-emit removed, ctor wire-in mutation-anchored). 0 new suite regressions vs the 61 baseline.
